name: Vibsync
description:
Vibsync gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI coding agents long-term team memory and live work context. It carries both what
the team knows — discoveries, fixes, failed approaches, product rules, and decisions — and what the team is doing now — questions, tasks, ownership, and active work areas — across sessions and machines. Git remains the source of
truth for code; Vibsync keeps the context around the work. It works alongside existing agents rather than launching, routing, or controlling them. Bring your own model; Vibsync does not run inference.

[ja] Vibsync は Claude Code・Cursor・Codex などのAIコーディングエージェントに、長期的なチームメモリと現在の作業状況を与えます。発見、修正方法、失敗したアプローチ、プロダクトルール、意思決定といった「チームが知っていること」に加え、質問、タスク、担当、作業中の領域といった「チームが今していること」を、セッションやマシンを越えて引き継ぎます。コードの正本はGitのまま、Vibsyncが作業の
周辺にあるコンテキストを保持します。既存のエージェントを起動・振り分け・制御するオーケストレーターではありません。利用者自身のモデルを使い、Vibsyncは推論を実行しません。

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vibsync to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vibsync to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vibsync.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vibsync MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vibsync lists 20 MCP tools, including ask, check_conflicts, claim, claim_task, context, create_task, dedup, forget, inbox, list_tasks, list_threads, and onboard.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vibsync?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Vibsync in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Vibsync requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vibsync is developed by LOOSEDAYS Co., Ltd.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
